verdict.rationale: cubic's documented capabilities stop at reviewing and patching pull requests that already exist. Nothing in the evidence shows it taking a tracked issue and producing a new pull request end-to-end. The closest features are adjacent: it can check an existing PR against linked Linear/Jira issue requirements, and it can push one-click fixes for review comments to an existing PR branch.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
